meta.name: motion-graphics
meta.description: A short, design-led motion graphic where motion is the message — kinetic typography, stat count-up, chart/data-viz hit, logo sting / brand lockup, lower-third / callout / social overlay, animated map (highlight regions, connect places, zoom to a location), animated tweet / news-article / headline, webpage / UI animation (scroll, cursor, callouts), or fusing a real image's geometry into a chart. Usually under 10s (up to ~30s), no narration or live-action subject; renders to MP4 or transparent overlay. Longer / narrated / multi-scene → /general-video. Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把数字、标题或品牌标志做成几秒钟的动态短片
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想用短短几秒的动效把数字、标题或品牌讲清楚
copy.tagline_en: Turn a stat, headline, or logo into a few seconds of animated motion.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a few-second animated clip to make a number or brand land.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会自主做一支短片动态图形(动态文字、数字滚动、图表、logo 动画、地图等):先定素材策略再设计镜头,复用现成模块搭建,最后渲染成 MP4 或透明叠加层,产物放在 videos/<项目名>/ 下。
howto.when: 当你需要一支 10 秒左右、没有旁白和真人出镜的纯设计动态图(动态文字、数字滚动、图表等)时接管;更长、带旁白或多场景则走 /general-video,不确定时先走 /hyperframes。

say.text: 做一支 8 秒的动态文字标题动画,文字是「新品发布」。
say.note: 没有素材需求,直接进入设计与搭建。

say.text: 把销售额数字从 0 滚到 12,800,带环形进度。
say.note: 归入 stat 分类,做数字滚动加环形。

say.text: 先给我看预览,确认后再渲染 MP4。
say.note: 进入预览/渲染的审批环节。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude autonomously makes a short design-led motion graphic (kinetic type, stat count-up, charts, logo stings, maps, etc.), then renders it to MP4 or a transparent overlay.
howto.when_en: Use it for a ~10s unnarrated, no live-action motion graphic (kinetic type, stat count-up, charts, etc.); longer or narrated work goes to /general-video; unclear ones start at /hyperframes.

say_en.text: Make an 8-second kinetic-type title animation reading "New Product Launch".
say_en.note: No assets needed; goes straight to design and build.

say_en.text: Count the sales figure up from 0 to 12,800 with a progress ring.
Show me a preview first, then render the MP4.
